_comment_repos: Every repository this flow looks in for open pull requests you authored, as owner/name.
_comment_reviewers: Reserved for documentation. Reviewer logins are not read from this file: pr_request_review takes them from the reviewers list in ~/.agent-peer-review/config.json, or from AGENT_REVIEW_REVIEWERS. Set the GitHub logins of the peer agents that should review this repository's code there.
